description: This file defines the X509AuthHandler class, which is a handler for authenticating HTTP clients via X.509 client certificates within the org.eclipse.hono.service.http package. It extends Vert.x's AuthHandlerImpl to validate client certificates during SSL sessions and retrieve device credentials based on the subject DN of the certificates.

classes.name: X509AuthHandler
classes.description: A Vert.x web handler for authenticating clients using X.509 certificates. It extends AuthHandlerImpl and uses an X509Authentication instance to validate client certificates extracted from SSL sessions. Upon successful validation, it provides device credentials. It also handles exceptions during authentication.

methods.name: X509AuthHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with an X509Authentication instance and an authentication provider.

methods.name: parseCredentials
methods.description: Extracts and validates the client's X.509 certificate from the SSL session during an HTTP request, and sets the result to the provided handler.

methods.name: processException
methods.description: Handles errors that occur during authentication, invoking a utility method to process exceptions appropriately.
